pages.text: A [[charging_rail]] made of [[electrum]]: it moves up to 4,000 FE per tick, keeping 500 FE in reserve.

It draws from a [[charging_station]] or [[substation]] within **4 chunks**, twice the charging rail's reach. A locomotive tops up much faster on it, as long as the power network can keep up.

**Lines:** electrum rails joined along the track pass charge to each other, carrying power past that range. The far end of a long line fills slowly, and a gap or a bronze rail stops the flow.
